note_en: Notice how 把 moves the object in front of the verb: 智能管家轻轻把你叫醒 "a smart home assistant gently wakes you up." English always says verb + object, but Chinese uses 把 + object + verb + result (叫醒, "call" + "awake") when something is done to the object with a definite outcome. Also note that 会 has two jobs here: 会飞的汽车 is "a car that can fly" (ability), while 交流会变得越来越少 is "will become less and less" (likely future).
